# React Native Bundle Discovery

> Visualize and analyze the JS bundle of your React Native app

## Docs

- [Introduction](/bundle-discovery/docs/getting-started/introduction.md): Visualize and analyze the JS bundle of your React Native app. Find heavy packages, duplicates and deprecated dependencies, inspect every module, and catch bundle size regressions in CI.
- [Quick start](/bundle-discovery/docs/getting-started/quick-start.md): This setup is for a standard Metro project. Using Re.Pack or Rozenite? See Other setups.
- [Other setups](/bundle-discovery/docs/getting-started/other-setups.md)
- [UI](/bundle-discovery/docs/guides/ui.md): Requires react-native-bundle-discovery-ui. See it in action in the live demo (a static build with --compare). The top bar shows the platform, whether the bundle is a production/minified build (warns about dev or unminified bundles), the total size split into your code and node_modules, and the report build date.
- [CLI](/bundle-discovery/docs/guides/cli.md): Requires react-native-bundle-discovery-cli. Run any command with --help to see all options. To fail CI on bundle size regressions, see Bundle size checks in CI.
- [Bundle size checks in CI](/bundle-discovery/docs/guides/ci.md): compare exits with code 1 when any check fails:
- [Re.Pack](/bundle-discovery/docs/guides/repack.md): For projects using Re.Pack there are two ways to use react-native-bundle-discovery: As the BundleDiscoveryPlugin Webpack/Rspack pluginOr with a JSON report from Rsdoctor
- [rnx-kit (esbuild metafile)](/bundle-discovery/docs/guides/rnx-kit.md): With @rnx-kit/metro-serializer-esbuild (tree shaking), ask it to write an esbuild metafile via the treeShake options in package.json: Then create a production bundle with react-native rnx-bundle --platform ios --dev false (the path to the metafile is printed in the build log). The UI and CLI accept the metafile as is (sizes are after tree shaking and minification):
- [React Native DevTools (Rozenite)](/bundle-discovery/docs/guides/rozenite.md): Use the UI inside React Native DevTools. The plugin is built on top of Rozenite.
- [AI coding agent](/bundle-discovery/docs/guides/ai-agent.md): Using Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another coding agent? Skip the manual setup and point your agent at the setup-react-native-bundle-discovery skill. It installs the package and sets up Metro or Re.Pack for you. The skill configures the bundler so the report is generated only when the BUNDLE_ANALYZER environment variable is set.
- [createSerializer](/bundle-discovery/docs/api/create-serializer.md): Creates a Metro serializer that writes the JSON report. Use it as serializer.customSerializer (see Quick start).
- [createResolveRequest](/bundle-discovery/docs/api/create-resolve-request.md): Creates a Metro resolveRequest that removes unnecessary React Native modules from release bundles (dev builds are not affected). The CLI recommends these options when they apply to your bundle.
- [Similar projects](/bundle-discovery/docs/similar-projects.md): expo-atlasexpo-atlas-without-exporeact-native-bundle-visualizerwebpack-bundle-analyzerbundle-statsstatoscope Built with Discovery.js (views showcase, Jora syntax).
